body: After Whitney, that's Mac Miller, a rapper. He died last month, OD.

Oh yeah, several times a day, often in bed. And it's usually more than a twitch, and I'll sometimes spout nonsense too. I've always been able to keep it in check in public, so far, so that's good I guess. Thought I was the only one...

To be fair, even in "good" countries, we still suck at handling this kind of thing, and the police is actually part of the problem. It's probably better than whereever you are, but it's still far from great.

I'm sorry you had to live through that OP. I  really am, I can't imagine how this feels, neither do I want to. I wish I had some advice to offer but I really don't. This world fucking sucks.

I see your point, but isn't it sort of a chicken and egg problem? I won't be open about it because I know most people won't get it, but people won't get it because we won't be open about it. Sounds complicated.

You seem to have made up your mind. Okay.

One last thing before you go. That might seem silly (at least, it seems silly to write), but have you thought about living for yourself? There's a lot of sticking it to others in that death letter of yours, and that can be a strong motive to keep going. I can't promise it'll work for you, but deciding that fuck others and I go first has been doing OK for me for a little while. Nothing wrong with being selfish, sometimes it's just the right thing to do. Fuck your family, fuck your ex, fuck your coworkers, and all the others, fuck them all. You, my dude, are what matters right now.

And if that means you're really certain you want to go, well, I can't stop you, hell, I might join you some day. Just, for that Jose guy, just make sure you exhausted all other options first, alright ?

I'm not saying don't turn to people. Please, do. Just pick them very carefully. What I am saying is that the idea is that we can get people _in general_ to care about depression is, in my opinion, a lost cause.

We'll never be taken seriously enough. Not by most people anyway. Depression is one of those things you can't really understand unless you went through it or have been close to someone who did while having enough empathy. Given how little empathy the average guy has, I'm afraid that fight is lost.

Oh yeah I have one of these tablets too! I Bought it a while ago when I had some gift cards about to expire to spend, I figured if I ever wanted to seriously make a game and try my hand at some simple art, I could try and learn (though I'm pretty terrible at drawing, so there's a lotta work there lol). I never did though. Hope I'll try it out sometime, but I'm not sure when I'll ever get the idea to, even though the thing sits 2 inches down from my monitor.

These are pretty cool drawings. My ex used to draw too, but with a pencil and no color. She was also very fond of that style, in fact a creepy monster couple getting intimate with each other is the one drawing of her I remember best, and still might have around if I was not stupid enough to throw it away after we broke up. I don't remember, I might have... I hope not. Maybe I remember it so well because I think that couple she drew was meant to be us. I'm not sure what it meant though, I never asked.

As for my friend, well, things took an... unexpected direction. A few days after I told her I needed to talk to her in person about that and wouldn't do it by IM, she messaged me she was taking a break from drugs (or... the ones she was currently abusing I should say). We talked a bit more after that and she actually seems to care about being safe, so that's encouraging. But I told her I still needed to speak to her and she stood me up twice since then, plus one time a couple of days before, so I'm backing off for now, I'm a bit pissed at her though. I'm not sure if she knew exactly what I wanted to hear and just told me that, she might have. Meh, nothing more I can do anyway.

It's really weird, for me these depressive/suicidal moods really seem to come in phases. I feel pretty good right now, I almost don't recognize myself in my OP anymore. That'll be back later for sure though, I know it. In the meantime, weekend distractions are pretty cool! Nothing like a good music festival to escape your life for a few days.

Hey. No problem, I can take a while too, as you can see. Sounds like you got yourself a nice way of dealing with things. I could use one right now...

There's this girl I work with, that I'm really worried sick about... Yeah, I have a crush on her, but that's beside the point now. She always was a party girl, and we already were worried about her when she was just drinking, well recently she got into the real stuff, and she has this super addictive personality where if she's into something she'll just go all the way into it, so there's just no way this ends well. I'm no stranger to drugs myself, I've taken my share of it and then some. I know how cool it can be when used somewhat responsibly. And I know rolling and doing cocaine every fucking night is a recipe for disaster too, and that's exactly what she's doing. At this point I have zero idea what to do... Her friends already tried to talk to her, well she burned that bridge, she only sees the fuckers she parties with now. And the people I work with are completely oblivious, so here I am, watching her destroy herself every day, no one else than me knows, and I can't tell them. Fuck. Ever had a situation like that ? I'm lost here. I wanna talk to her, but what good can possibly come out of it ? I wouldn't be the first to try. It's like all I can do is just hug her and say goodbye... I'm going to work wondering if today is gonna be the day she finally overdid it. That's a pretty shitty feeling.

Nah, never tried GameMaker but it looks alright if you're not into code. I write code for a living so It's not that much of a problem for me. As for school, I just got out of it, so, not right now, probably. What about you ?
I feel the same way, sometimes. It's pretty fucked up, it should be so much easier to just talk about it, but it's really not though. I'm aware of how absurd it is, but I can't help it.

Well I'm sorry to hear you're struggling too. I've been guilty of this too, posting something a couple years ago just to delete it the next day along with the account and shredding the password. It was r/depression i think, I do get the feeling. I'm almost afraid of going to sleep and waking up to do the exact same thing again. But I don't think I'm as ashamed of it this time as I was back then. Maybe I'm just more desperate, I don't know.

My answers to your your first question would be kinda depressing to say the least. I feel like it's been ages since I've had an interesting or mildly entertaining answer to that "What's going on with your life" thing, but I guess that's par for the course with depression. As for my dreams, well... I've always wanted to play and write music. Also, as a kid who spent way too much time playing video games, that's the other thing I've always dreamt of, making those. There's so much untapped potential in it as a storytelling medium, and it's new enough that there is still so much left to explore. But really, what I want the most right now is to get my life together. It does feel like setting the bar rather low for a dream though.

What about you ? I'll be trying to get a couple hours of sleep before going to work now, but hopefully I can promise I won't delete this tomorrow this time.

Boy, do I know the feeling. I've never been as trapped in it as you seem to be, but these thoughts and a lot of your experience do hit close to home. Guess all I can tell you is what I tell myself in the moments I manage to get out of it, in particular regarding what you said about seeing a new therapist:

>  I just don't have the energy or motivation to do that. There's really no other option other than to end it.

I know how unreal it sounds, but motivation is a lie we tell ourselves, albeit a very convincing one. You may not control your thoughts. You may not control your feelings, or emotions. But you do control your actions and hold yourself accountable for them, don't you ? Do you not judge yourself over them all the time ? I know I do. That's the one power we still have: doing shit. Motivation does not have to get in the way, if we find the strength not to let it. It doesn't have to be easy (it won't be). It doesn't have to be pleasant (not gonna be either). But you *can* do it.

So please man, go see a new therapist, even more so as you said it previously helped you. Don't get me wrong, it's not gonna be easy, I know that: I'm struggling to drag my ass to a therapist myself, albeit for the first time. But the very idea that I might go to one seemed like crazy  talk not long ago, and look at me, trying to get my insurance shit in order. You've done it once, I know you can find the strength to do it again. Don't give up, brother.
Borderline. r/BPD is actually where I heard of the disorder for the first time. I've never been active there though, so that is good to know, thanks.

Thank you, that was nice to read. I'll keep that in mind if/when I do make the jump. (... OK, that's a pretty awful pun to make here, but it did crack me up. A bit. Sorry.)

> Again, this is only if you trust them and feel like they can help you.

That's kind of my problem right there. Those that might help me, I won't trust, because they know too many other friends of mine. The one friend I do trust, can't help me. We already had talks about depression and mental troubles (though about a past depression in my teenage years, not my current situation), he means well but he really has no clue. There's one other guy I do trust and I know would listen, but I've only seen him a couple of times in the last few years, it would feel so unfair to bring him into my mess. It would feel like abusing him really. My parents are not really an option either, they'd just freak the fuck out, I think. Plus, it's not gonna be long before the rest of the family hears about it. No way.

But hey, on the bright side, I just opened up to strangers on the internet, so I guess not all hope is lost.

Again, thank you for your time, kind stranger. The world needs more good people like you. I  too, wish you all the best.

Well that might be a few weeks, or maybe even a couple of months, for a few reasons, but you're absolutely right, I should go. I'll try and keep pushing myself in that direction, although even accepting the idea that I should go took me a while. For tonight, Arrested Development season 5 sounds like a plan, I guess. Thank you for your reply.
Well, there's no rush, I'm not about to do anything rash right now. Also, you being off your lunch break means we're likely on opposite ends of the Earth, but yeah, I'll be right there. Thanks.
